newsitem.title: UK: TI Group firms on newspaper recommendation.
newsitem.headline: TI Group firms on newspaper recommendation.

text.p: Shares in TI Group Plc firmed in pre-market trade on Wednesday after the Daily Telegraph newspaper recommended buying shares in the UK engineering firm ahead of its half-year results later in the month, dealers said.
TI Group shares were 12p stronger at 504-1/2 by 0718 GMT.
The Telegraph's "Questor" share tips column said that even on slightly reduced profit forecasts, the shares were trading at 15 times expected earnings.
"It looks too low for a group that has consistently demonstrated ability to generate strong organic growth and make well-judged acquisitions," the Telegraph said.

The newspaper said while the strength of sterling would have a translational effect on TI's overseas earnings, it would not damage the company's competitiveness, as a large proportion of its products were made outside Britain.

"Even with the pound at over three marks and $1.67, the effect on TI's profits should be only about three million stg this year and 10 million next time," it said. "At a group expected to make over 230 million stg this year, it is hardly life-threatening."
